claim: Clients of an ElastiCache Serverless cache connect to a single endpoint, so the node topology can change without disconnecting the client. Clients of a node-based cluster connect to each cache node and rediscover the topology if a node is replaced.
question: How do clients connect to a serverless cache compared with a node-based cluster?

values.display: Clients connect to a single endpoint
Clients connect to each individual cache node
